$comment: chromokit's own tokens: the measures of a documentation page and the marks, which chromosomix's app stylesheet has no reason to declare. Hand-maintained; sizes in px are converted to rem at a 16px root.

categorical.$comment: Series colours for plots, in order: the accent, then six of the family colours, the subset whose closest pair is furthest apart under normal vision and the three simulated deficiencies, in both palettes (test/colours.test.mjs holds them to the family thresholds).

family.$comment: One colour per kind of genomics data, from chromomap's src/ui/styles/tokens.css (js2264/chromomap@2b5dfe5, MIT, same author), chosen there under a test this repository runs too (test/colours.test.mjs): at least 3:1 against every surface, every pair at least ΔE 12 apart (8 under simulated protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia), at least ΔE 15 from the accent and from every state colour. Related families share a hue: genome and index, fragments and pairs. Never a grey, since greys are states.

state.$comment: What a job, a block or a run is doing, from chromomap (docs/ui.md §4.2). Running is a violet of its own, since the accent already means selection and focus; the others read the palette's own colours. A state is never colour alone: a ring's shape and its word go with it (.cx-ring, .cx-state).
